WITH l0 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t.* FROM "Wells" t WHERE (TRUE) AND geometry IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geometry))
SELECT p."OBJECTID", p."well_name", p."wellbore_name", p."purpose", p."content", p."field_name", p."multilateral", p."entry_date", p."completion_date", p."status", p."water_depth", p."production_facility", p."source", p."well_type", p."discovery_wellbore", p."drilling_operator", p."drilling_facility", p."production_licence", p."country", p."formation_tops", p."geochem_info", p."log", p."mud", p."oil_samples", p."old_wdss", p."paly_slides", p."wellbore_history", p."npd_papers", p."cuttings_sample", p."core_sample", p."content_type", ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS __geojson FROM l0 p WHERE TRUE ORDER BY p.OBJECTID LIMIT ?
